Front Counter Support

★ ★ ★ ★ ★ 5.0 (0 reviews)

Colour / finish — #4 brushed stainless

  • Structure to support front of house millwork or tile front walls
  • Adjustable height cross brace brackets for cart stops and magnets
  • Designed to be anchored to the floor

Overview

The Front Counter Support is intended to replace stud or millwork die wall structures where required.  Front face is designed to support millwork panels or plywood for tile walls.  The rear face has height adjustable brackets to ensure cross braces are able to be levelled and engage rolling carts at the correct heights for stops or magnets.  To be securely anchored to the floor.
